title: the ReBAR axis — the founder's mis-detected Auto, measured to the byte
instruments: lab/fw49-rebar.py (axis/pair/nullrebar/selftest/manifest), composing frozen fw37 pierce + fw43 module/forms machinery; ring-8 SCSU machinery reached through the packed-UTF-16 label table instead (the Setup module's strings are utf16z entries separated by one 0x14 byte)
laws: L1 labels-over-guesses: a string is claimed only when anchor-verified both ways (tok 1281 'Above 4G Decoding' -> tok 1283 'SR-IOV Support' forward, clean entry backward); unresolved tokens stay raw
L2 anchors-before-marks: every qid/tok/voff is extracted live and must reproduce this register or the instrument refuses loud
L3 zero writes: the instrument reads; this register is the single write of the ring
L4 compose-on-frozen: fw37/fw43 imported, never rewritten

vocabulary_law.finding: the word 'Resizable' is ABSENT from the whole decompressed surface of all three acquisitions (raw + recursive LZMA, ~48.6 MB each); the ASUS label is 'Resize BAR Support' — canonical-name searches find nothing
vocabulary_law.founder_report: 'le reshade bar ... il detecte mal alors que c'est en auto' = this option

axis_3644_wifi.rebar_help_text_tok1404:
If the system has Resize BAR capable PCIe Devices, this option Enables or Disables Resize BAR Support.(Only if System Support 64 bit PCI Decoding)
NOTE: To enable Resize BAR Support to fully harness GPU memory, please navigate to Boot section and disable CSM(Compatibility Support Module).

pair_laws.law: the release is rebar-axis-INVARIANT (rings 47-48: it rotates one DER certificate, not one setup bit); the board pair is invariant MODULO exactly one byte - the grayout operand's qid 0x361 -> 0x35F (the sibling's question space is two questions shorter, the WIFI questions it lacks)

os_side.rule: BAR1 total <= 256 MiB -> 'Resizable BAR likely disabled' (mis-adjusted, not defective)
os_side.note: the finding itself says the BIOS half is not observable from the OS — ring 49 is that half, measured

day0_day1.firmware_side: the option stays 'Resize BAR Support' [Auto] through the 16/09 flash (the release is axis-invariant); Auto engages only when the vendor help's conditions hold: 64-bit PCI decoding (Above 4G Decoding) + CSM disabled in the Boot section + a ReBAR-capable GPU
linux_verification: omarchy-firmware diag-gpu -> gpu-bar1-small if BAR1 <= 256 MiB (ReBAR off)
sudo lspci -vv -s <gpu> | grep -A4 'Physical Resizable BAR' -> 'current size' equals VRAM when engaged
cat /proc/iomem -> GPU BARs above the 4 GB line when Above 4G decoding is active

open_questions: the option-label tokens 3/4/5 live in the SCSU-compressed strings package the ring-8 walker cannot cleanly decode (garbage windows) — the common labels (Auto/Enabled/Disabled) stay unresolved; the axis labels are anchor-resolved and unaffected
qid 0x361 (grayout operand, WIFI II) / 0x35F (sibling) is a hidden question (prompt tok 0 in the walked candidates) — its identity is open; the vendor help names the CSM condition independently
the CSM question itself lives in the Boot formset, outside this ring's walked bodies
